mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers a labor market tightening effect, reducing labor demand and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when UNRATE crosses below 5.0%, or the decline in UNRATE does not precede the return movement.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a tightening monetary policy cycle, increasing risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS rises above 1.0% and UNRATE falls below 5.0% in the next month
failure_condition: The combined effect of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE movements does not produce negative returns when both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index above 105.0 signals robust economic production and reduced inflationary pressures, boosting consumer and business confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not sustain above 105.0 for the next 5 days, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing financing costs on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS decline does not produce positive 60-day forward returns, or returns are negative despite the rate cut (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2.0% and a concurrent increase in the federal funds rate above 1.0% signal a dual inflation and tightening cycle, raising risk aversion and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both CPIAUCSL rises above 2.0% and FEDFUNDS rises above 1.0% in the next month
failure_condition: The combined effect of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS movements does not produce negative returns when both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in employment numbers (PAYEMS) below 135,000 in the next month signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which depresses equity valuations and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 135,000 in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when PAYEMS crosses below 135,000, or the decline in employment does not precede the return movement.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained rise in the INDPRO supply index above 105.0 amplifies confidence in economic growth, reduces uncertainty, and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not sustain above 105.0 for the next 60 days, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
